name: Dev Learning Archaeologist
author: KyaniteLabs
description: Turns a repo's git history into evidence for a learning diagnostic: deterministic ground truth (commit counts, identity consolidation, branch dedup) and excavation (commit-type taxonomy, temporal bursts and gaps, rework hotspots, co-authorship) per Phases 0-1 of the Dev Learning Archaeologist methodology, plus the byte-identical vendored methodology documents that guide the agent-side Phase 2-5 judgment. Read-only over git history; the analyzed repo must sit under a scan-root boundary; author emails are always masked.

grantPresets.label: Local git history reads
grantPresets.description: Allow the archaeologist to read git history of repositories that sit under the configured scan root (DLA_SCAN_ROOT, default var/scan-root inside the add-on). Read-only: no git command writes to the analyzed repository; author emails are masked in all outputs.

tools.name: dla.status
tools.description: Report service version, methodology commit pin, busy state, the most recent excavation id, and the active scan-root boundary.

scan_root.description: Confinement root (home paths redacted to ~); repos outside it are refused

tools.name: dla.contributors
tools.description: Phase 0 step 1 for a multi-author repo: the contributor table (identities consolidated by shared email or normalized name, commit counts, agent/bot-looking identities flagged, emails masked) so a caller can pick one author before dla.excavate. The repo path must sit under DLA_SCAN_ROOT.

repo.description: Repository path to read, confined to DLA_SCAN_ROOT (default var/scan-root inside the add-on)
Resolved repo root, home paths redacted to ~

tools.name: dla.excavate
tools.description: Deterministic Phase 0 (ground truth: raw/dedup/logical commit counts verified against git rev-list, active days, span, identity consolidation, branch dedup within 5 minutes, batch-merge detection) and Phase 1 (excavate: commit-type taxonomy with scope analysis and verb fallback, hourly/daily distributions, burst-gap cycles, frustration-level rework hotspots, Co-Authored-By MER proxy) over one repo's git history. Phases 2-5 (eras, the 7 analysis vectors, the HTML report) are agent judgment — fetch the methodology with dla.docs/dla.doc. Optional author filter scopes everything to one contributor and reports what percent of repo activity they represent. Emails masked; result persisted home-path-redacted under var/. One history read at a time.

repo.description: Repository path to read, confined to DLA_SCAN_ROOT (default var/scan-root inside the add-on)

author.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against author names/emails to scope the analysis to one contributor (rules.md Phase 0 multi-author rule)

repo.description: Resolved repo root, home paths redacted to ~

contributor_pct_of_repo.description: When an author filter is set: percent of total repo activity the analyzed set represents

ground_truth.description: total_commits_raw, total_commits_after_dedup, logical_commits_after_batch_merge, batch_merge_groups, active_days, span_days, active_day_ratio, first_commit, last_commit

identities.description: clusters (display_name, names, emails_masked, commits, pct, agent_marker), multi_author, gap_boundary_rule

temporal.description: gap_boundary_hours, hourly, daily, peak_hour, peak_day, bursts_gaps, burst_to_gap_ratio

hotspots.description: files with 3+ modifications, frustration level 1-4, message signal counts; era scoping is agent work

excavation_id.description: Wrapper-assigned id; the same redacted record is persisted at record_path

record_path.description: Addon-relative path of the persisted redacted excavation.json under var/

tools.name: dla.docs
tools.description: List the vendored Dev Learning Archaeologist methodology documents (byte-identical to upstream commit fbb375b): identity, rules (the 5-phase pipeline), examples, signal heuristics, output schemas, HTML report spec, verified creators, data enrichment.

tools.name: dla.doc
tools.description: Read one vendored methodology document verbatim (rules.md for the 5-phase pipeline and 7 vectors, reference/signal-heuristics.md for formulas, reference/output-schemas.md for structured output contracts, etc.).

name.description: Document name as listed by dla.docs
